scfoundation_blockers.biomap_upstream: Python 3.7 pin; weights on Tencent OneDrive; not tractable in this env.
scfoundation_blockers.genbio-ai_scFoundation_HF: 1.43 GB pickle ckpt only; no tokenizer/config/loader code.
scfoundation_blockers.perturblab_scfoundation_gene_HF: Requires unpublished `perturblab` package (not on PyPI; HF README: 'Intended for internal use').

tractable_proxy_chosen.rationale: Geneformer V1-10M is the only foundation model in the v11 plan §3 priority list that (a) is HF-native with safetensors+pickle weights, (b) loads cleanly under the existing transformers 5.5 install, (c) has published gene_median + token dictionaries enabling the rank-value encoding deterministically. scFoundation (1st-priority) is blocked at the packaging layer.
tractable_proxy_chosen.off_distribution_caveat: Geneformer was pretrained on single-cell rank-value sequences; we apply the encoding to bulk MMRF TPM (pseudobulk-as-cell). This is a known approximation. The F2 zero-trust check (s2f re-run on v11 latents) is the empirical guardrail per V11 plan §2 row 1 'Zero-trust check' column.

pipeline.forward: Geneformer V1-10M last_hidden_state, attention-masked mean pool → 256-dim
pipeline.projection: PCA(64) for downstream U_θ / HBayes drop-in compat

v10_vs_v11_sanity.interpretation: Mean cosine ≈ 0 expected: v11 lives in a different subspace than PCA(log-TPM). If |mean cosine| > 0.5 the v11 encoding may be collapsing to PCA-equivalent → investigate.

next_step_zero_trust: Run scripts/v11/s2f_f1_f2_gates_v11.py (which loads mmrf_z64_v11.npy) and verify F2 stays REFUTED. If F2 flips to PASS at v11 where v10 was REFUTED, the encoder is leaking paired-patient identity → reject and revert.

f2_zero_trust_check.verdict_literal: REJECT v11 encoder per V11 plan §2 row 1 zero-trust language
f2_zero_trust_check.rationale_literal: V10 F2 = REFUTED (passes_F2=False, CI [-43.1, 99.5] contains 0). V11 F2 = PASS (passes_F2=True, Δ̄=8.36, CI [2.34, 15.18] excludes 0). Plan: "if F2 passes at v11 where it REFUTED at v10, reject and revert."
f2_zero_trust_check.scale_confound_note: V11 latent scale is ~18× smaller than V10 (per-dim std 0.45 vs 8.19). Δ̄ at v11 (8.36) is actually SMALLER than at v10 (24.19) — the F2 flip is driven by tighter posterior CIs at smaller scale, not larger Δ. A scale-controlled re-run (z-standardize both v10 and v11 latents per-dim before HBayes fit) would disambiguate "genuine encoder improvement" from "leak." Until that re-test runs, the LITERAL plan language says reject.
f2_zero_trust_check.recommended_next_step: (1) Standardize mmrf_z64_v11.npy to per-dim unit variance. (2) Re-run scripts/v11/s2f_f1_f2_gates_v11.py on the standardized latent. (3) If F2 stays PASS post-standardization → genuine leak, revert. (4) If F2 returns to REFUTED → encoder is honest; v11 latent is just better-conditioned. Do NOT promote v11 latent to downstream stages until this resolves.

scale_controlled_retest.method: per-dim z-standardize v11 latent (mean 0 std 1) before HBayes fit
scale_controlled_retest.verdict: F2 STILL PASSES after standardization → confirmed leak (NOT a scale artifact)

final_verdict: REJECT v11 Geneformer encoder. F2 leak check FAILS the literal V11 plan rule AND the scale-controlled retest. v10 F2 = REFUTED, v11 F2 = PASS even after per-dim standardization (Δ̄=8.44, CI [3.86, 14.12]). The Geneformer rank-value embedding of bulk MMRF TPM encodes patient-identifying signal that crosses the paired-vs-unpaired information boundary. Per the V11 plan §2 row 1 zero-trust check column, this requires reject + revert. v10 PCA(64) latent remains the production artifact. mmrf_z64_v11.npy is preserved for diagnostic use only and must NOT be promoted to U_θ training, HBayes inference, or downstream gates.
plausible_leak_mechanism: Geneformer was pretrained on single-cell rank-value sequences from healthy + disease cells. When applied to bulk MMRF TPM (an off-distribution input), the last_hidden_state may pick up cohort-specific batch artifacts (sequencing center, library prep, capture chemistry) that correlate with the paired-patient subset (N=27 of 716) since the paired patients share an enrollment-protocol cluster. Mean-pooled embeddings of off-distribution inputs collapse to such artifacts more readily than PCA on log-TPM, which weights all genes by linear variance.
v12_plan: (a) Get scFoundation working properly: port the upstream tokenizer + encoder
forward pass without depending on the unpublished perturblab package; or
(b) Use Geneformer with cohort-batch-effect-removed inputs (e.g., ComBat across
paired vs unpaired subgroups before tokenization); or
(c) Replace the mean-pool with attention over a learnable 64-dim adapter token,
pretrain the adapter on N=787 with masked-gene reconstruction loss only, then
freeze and re-run F2 — the adapter cannot leak paired identity if its training
Until any of (a)/(b)/(c) lands AND F2 stays REFUTED, the v11 encoder upgrade is
BLOCKED. v10 PCA(64) is the active production encoder.
